result.stdout:
Anvil - a minimal server-rendered .NET framework
Version: 0.1.0

Commands:
  anvil new <name>       Create a new Anvil application
  anvil dev               Run the current app with dotnet watch
  anvil ui [list|add]     Manage editable UI components
  anvil build|publish     Build or publish the current app
  anvil docker            Generate deployment templates
  anvil release --check   Run release diagnostics
  anvil check|fmt         Check or format the current app
  anvil doctor             Diagnose deployment readiness
  anvil mail               Inspect or preview mail
  anvil routes|asset      Inspect routes or asset guidance

Options:
  anvil --version
  anvil dev --project <path>
  anvil new <name> --output <directory> [--profile default|identity] [--database sqlite|sqlserver|postgresql|mysql] [--package-source <directory>] [--no-restore] [--force]
  anvil make resource|endpoint|page|shard|crud <Name> [--force]
  anvil make:page <Name> [--force]
  anvil make:shard <Name> [--force]
  anvil generate [--check]
  anvil migrate [--dry-run]
  anvil doctor [--production]
  anvil doctor --provider sqlite|sqlserver|postgresql|mysql
  anvil mail [status|preview <message.json>]
  anvil docker [--force]
  anvil release --check
  anvil jobs status
  anvil schedule list
